subject: E-3196: TLS handshake failed on macOS
body:
Good forenoon. My setup is MeshMail 2.8.8, macOS 14.7. Whenever I open the app
since this forenoon, the app displays 'E-3196: TLS handshake failed'.

The clock displays a wrong date since the motherboard battery died. The login page
in the browser also shows a certificate warning.

I've already attempted rebooting the router, which changed nothing.

Daniel Ortega -- Brightwater Clinics. Appreciate any hints.
